shortSummary: Core financial ledger managing participant accounts, limits, positions, and 2-phase commit transfers.
behindTheScenes: On boot, calls Migrator.migrate() in src/shared/setup.js to create 108 MySQL tables via Knex.js (src/migrations/) and seed baseline enums (src/seeds/amountType.js, Hub participant). Exposes Admin API (port 3001) and runs Kafka consumers for topic-transfer-prepare, topic-transfer-fulfil, and position handling.
developerCustomization: Modify business logic in central-ledger/src/, database schemas in src/migrations/, or seeds in src/seeds/. Rebuild locally and update CENTRAL_LEDGER_VERSION in .env.

shortSummary: High-throughput Kafka consumer worker processing batched participant position adjustments.
behindTheScenes: Uses the same mojaloop/central-ledger codebase but executes `node src/handlers/index.js handler --positionbatch`. Consumes `topic-transfer-position-batch` to debit Payer and credit Payee positions atomically in MySQL without locking the HTTP API server.
developerCustomization: Code lives in central-ledger/src/handlers/positions/. Shares database config with central-ledger via docker/config-modifier/configs/central-ledger.js.

shortSummary: MongoDB 8.0 document store persisting central-ledger audit events (`mlos`) and TTK reports (`ttk`).
behindTheScenes: Exposed on port 27017. Stores two critical databases: `mlos` (immutable event audit trail from central-ledger) and `ttk` (`reports` collection rendered on `/admin/reports`).
developerCustomization: Query reports via `docker exec objstore mongosh ttk --eval "db.reports.find()"`.

shortSummary: One-shot init container that pre-creates all required Mojaloop Kafka topics and partitions.
behindTheScenes: Connects to `kafka:29092` on startup, runs the topic creation script (`docker/kafka/scripts/`), ensures all transfer/quote/settlement topics exist with correct partitions, and exits with code 0.
developerCustomization: Topic definitions and partition counts are managed in docker/kafka/.

shortSummary: Distributed event streaming backbone decoupling API gateways, handlers, ledger, and notifications.
behindTheScenes: Runs in KRaft mode (port 9092/29092). Carries high-throughput async events across topics like `topic-transfer-prepare`, `topic-transfer-fulfil`, `topic-transfer-position-batch`, `topic-quotes-post`, and `topic-notification-event`.
developerCustomization: Inspect live topic lag and messages by launching the optional `debug` profile (`kafka-debug-ui`).

shortSummary: Primary MySQL 8.0 relational database housing the `central_ledger` schema (108 tables).
behindTheScenes: Auto-creates empty `central_ledger` database on startup via `MYSQL_DATABASE=central_ledger` and runs `docker/sql-init/01_permissions.sql`. Shared by central-ledger, quoting-service, and central-settlement for transfers, quotes, positions, and settlement windows.
developerCustomization: Expose port 3306 or use SSH tunnel in DBeaver (`central_ledger` / `password`) to inspect `transfer`, `participant`, and `participantPosition` tables.

shortSummary: Handles inter-DFSP quote negotiations, fee calculation, and cryptographic ILP conditions.
behindTheScenes: Processes POST /quotes, PUT /quotes/{ID}, and FX quotes on port 3002. Persists quote agreements in the shared central_ledger MySQL database (`quote`, `quoteResponse`, `fxQuote` tables) and publishes quote events to Kafka.
developerCustomization: Edit fee logic or quote validation rules in quoting-service/src/ and configure Kafka consumer topics in docker/config-modifier/configs/quoting-service.js.

shortSummary: Async Kafka worker handling quote processing and forwarding callbacks between Payer and Payee FSPs.
behindTheScenes: Runs `node dist/src/handlers/index.js` from the quoting-service image. Consumes `topic-quotes-post` and `topic-quotes-put` from Kafka, resolves Payee endpoints via central-ledger, and dispatches asynchronous callbacks.
developerCustomization: Shares source code with quoting-service; configure concurrency or topic partitions in docker/config-modifier/configs/quoting-service.js.

shortSummary: Inbound FSPIOP REST API gateway validating transfer requests and publishing events to Kafka.
behindTheScenes: Receives POST /transfers and PUT /transfers/{ID} from DFSPs on port 3000. Validates OpenAPI headers, JWS/signatures, and forwards transfer prepare/fulfil messages onto Kafka (`topic-transfer-prepare`, `topic-transfer-fulfil`). Also runs notification handler delivering callbacks back to DFSP endpoints.
developerCustomization: Customize inbound schema validation, error handling, or notification routing in ml-api-adapter/src/ and config in docker/config-modifier/configs/ml-api-adapter.js.

shortSummary: Generic mock participant backend simulating core banking responses for quotes, parties, and transfers.
behindTheScenes: Listens on port 8444. Used by SDK scheme adapters and TTK tests to simulate external DFSP core banking logic (accepting/rejecting deposits and lookups).
developerCustomization: Configure simulator party repository or custom responses via simulator test APIs.

command: sh -c "/opt/app/config-modifier/run.js /opt/app/config/default.json /opt/app/config-modifier/configs/account-lookup-service.js /opt/app/config/default.json && /opt/app/wait4/wait4.js account-lookup-service && npm run migrate && npm run start:all"
shortSummary: Party discovery & routing directory mapping identifiers (MSISDN, Account ID) to DFSPs.
behindTheScenes: Handles GET /parties/{Type}/{ID} (port 4001/4002). Consults registered Oracles in `mysql-als` (`oracleEndpoint` table) to determine which DFSP owns a phone number or account, then forwards discovery requests and PUT callbacks between banks. Note: Inter-scheme proxy cache is disabled in config-modifier for single-hub POC.
developerCustomization: Oracle routing config is seeded via `hub_setup_prod.json` (/oracles). Service config resides in docker/config-modifier/configs/account-lookup-service.js.

command: sh -c "/opt/app/config-modifier/run.js /opt/app/dist/config/default.json /opt/app/config-modifier/configs/als-msisdn-oracle-svc.js /opt/app/dist/config/default.json && /opt/app/wait4/wait4.js als-msisdn-oracle-svc && npm run migrate && node ./dist/src/cli.js"
shortSummary: Phone number (MSISDN) oracle service mapping mobile numbers to participant FSP IDs.
behindTheScenes: Runs Knex migrations on `mysql-als` (`oracleMSISDN` table) and serves REST lookups on port 3000. When ALS asks who owns `987654320`, this oracle returns the mapped FSP ID or falls back to simulator rules.
developerCustomization: Add or query MSISDN mappings via its REST API or directly inspect `oracleMSISDN` in the `mysql-als` database.

shortSummary: Dedicated MySQL 8.0 database for `account_lookup` and MSISDN oracle routing tables.
behindTheScenes: Stores `oracleEndpoint` registrations, `partyIdType` enums (MSISDN, ACCOUNT_ID, etc.), and `oracleMSISDN` phone number mappings.
developerCustomization: Initialization scripts reside in docker/sql-als-init/.

shortSummary: Automated test engine, mock DFSP simulator, OpenAPI validator, and WebSocket event streamer.
behindTheScenes: Listens on port 4040 (mock FSP callback server, mapped to host 9440) and port 5050 (control API & Socket.IO, mapped to host 9550). Runs Callback Rule Engine (`rules_callback/default.json` - Rule #223 returns "Justin Pierre Trudeau" for pinkbankfsp discovery). Captures all HTTP flows and streams real-time sequence diagrams over `/socket.io/` to the UI.
developerCustomization: Edit mock party data in docker/ml-testing-toolkit/spec_files/rules_callback/default.json or test environments in test-cases/environments/default-env.json.

shortSummary: Interactive web dashboard hosting Mobile Simulator (/mobilesimulator), Live Monitoring, and Test Reports.
behindTheScenes: Serves static React/AntD bundle on port 6060 (mapped to host 9660). Contains the Pink Bank & Green Bank mobile app UI (with frontend default phone number `987654320`), connects via WebSocket to port 9550 for real-time Sequence Diagrams and Pink/Green Bank HTTP logs, and reads persistent reports from MongoDB via TTK API.
developerCustomization: Configure `API_BASE_URL` in docker-compose.yml to match the server public IP so remote browsers can connect to port 9550.

shortSummary: Manages settlement windows, net settlement calculations, and deferred settlement rules.

Live server logs show it actively evaluating interchange fee rules (e.g., 0.60 XTS Wallet-to-Wallet between pinkbankfsp and greenbankfsp). Note: docker-compose healthcheck polls port 3001 instead of 3007, causing Docker status to show "health: starting" even though the process is alive and consuming Kafka events!
